title: Signposting in Academic Writing
text:
Signposting words guide readers through an argument. Writers use them to show how one idea connects to another. For instance, 'however' signals a contrast, while 'therefore' signals a conclusion. Without such markers, even a well-reasoned text can feel confusing.

Nevertheless, signposting should be used with care. Too many linking adverbials can make a text sound mechanical and repetitive. Furthermore, a writer who relies on them instead of clear logic may weaken the argument. Skilled writers therefore balance signposting with precise sentence structure.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does the word 'however' signal?
According to paragraph two, what can happen when a text contains too many linking adverbials?
options: It loses all of its contrasts

questions.text: What can be inferred about writers who rely on signposting instead of clear logic?
options: They always write the best arguments
They avoid using any linking words
They write only for specialist readers

questions.text: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: To explain how to write a dictionary
To argue that signposting should be used with balance
To show that linking adverbials should always be avoided
To describe the history of academic writing

vocabulary.definition: words that show the structure and direction of an argument
a clear difference between two ideas
a state in which different things are kept in proportion

paragraph_translations: Słowa sygnalizujące pomagają czytelnikowi przejść przez argumentację. Autorzy używają ich, aby pokazać, jak jedna myśl łączy się z drugą. Na przykład 'however' sygnalizuje kontrast, a 'therefore' sygnalizuje wniosek. Bez takich znaczników nawet dobrze uzasadniony tekst może wydawać się mylący.

Mimo to sygnalizację należy stosować ostrożnie. Zbyt wiele łączników może sprawić, że tekst zabrzmi mechanicznie i monotonnie. Ponadto autor, który polega na nich zamiast na jasnej logice, może osłabić swój argument. Doświadczeni autorzy dlatego równoważą sygnalizację precyzyjną budową zdań.
